## Knowledge Home

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad0797ab514b5/6ae91dd20c3bc92417911f6f_Knowledge%20Page%20(4).png)

‍

The new Knowledge Home brings your company’s engineering reference documents into one place in CoLab. Organize standards, specifications, design guidelines, and any other reference material your team uses in reviews.

Your team can browse these documents directly, and Operator and AutoReview can use relevant content in answers and reviews. Ask Operator to explain a requirement in a material specification, or make documented manufacturing guidance available to AutoReview when reviewing a drawing.

Open **Knowledge** from the left navigation to get started. Upload documents, organize them into folders, and use search and filters to find what you need. Company admins and users with the **Manage Knowledge** permission can maintain the collection; other team members can browse and open files.

Previously uploaded standards and guidelines are already in the **Standards and Guidelines** folder. They’ve moved out of AutoReview’s admin settings and continue working as before.

## Invitation reminders for admins

Admins will receive an email every 14 days showing how many recently invited users haven’t finished setting up their accounts. The email includes a link to review those users and resend their invitations.

### How it works

1. Follow the link in the email to open the Users table.
2. Users who haven’t signed up are automatically selected.
3. Review the selection and choose **Resend Invite** to send their invitations again.

You can also select users directly in the Users table and resend invitations to up to 1,000 eligible users at once.

### **More details**

- Emails are only sent when users invited in the past 14 days haven’t signed up.
- The link selects all users who haven’t signed up, including those invited earlier.
- These emails are enabled by default. You can turn them off in your notification settings.

## Create Feedback in Notebooks

‍

![Notebook text selected with the formatting toolbar and Create feedback action visible.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad0797ab514b5/6ad6c01a37a2dba31c741ad7_notebook-feedback-release.png)

You can now leave feedback on text and images in notebooks.

### How it works

1. Highlight text, an image, or text within a table cell, then select Create feedback from the formatting toolbar.
2. Write and submit your feedback. Open its pin in the notebook margin to view the feedback in the side panel.
3. Use the side panel to comment, assign feedback, or close it once it has been addressed. You can also navigate from feedback back to its associated notebook content.

### More details

- Changes to referenced text are recorded in feedback activity. If the referenced content is deleted, the feedback remains on the notebook.
- For read-only notebooks shared to portals, you can choose which feedback to share. Making a notebook editable in a portal shares all feedback on that notebook with the portal.
- A notebook can be editable in one portal. Sharing it to more than one portal makes it read-only in those portals.
- Feedback supports text within table cells, rather than entire tables, rows, or columns.

## Review Reminders

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad0797ab514b5/6a8471851593067c7a506dff_reviewreminders.png)

Company administrators can now configure automatic reminders for assigned reviewers based on a review’s due date. Reminders are delivered by email and through an in-app notification in CoLab.

### How it works

Go to **Settings** > **Company & Admin** \> **General** > **Reviews**, then turn on **Enable review reminders**.

For each reminder, choose how many days, weeks, or months before the due date it should be sent, then select a delivery time. Use **Add another reminder** to schedule additional notifications at different points in the review.

The example beneath the schedule shows the calculated delivery date, time, and time zone. Select **Update review settings** to save the schedule.

Once reminders are enabled, CoLab sends each scheduled notification to assigned reviewers who have not yet submitted. When a reviewer submits their review, their remaining reminders stop automatically.

### More details

- Multiple reminders can be configured for the same review due date
- Enter **0 days** to schedule a reminder on the due date
- Reminder settings apply across the company’s workspaces and portals
- Each reviewer stops receiving reminders after submitting their review

## 3-Point Section Planes

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad0797ab514b5/6a74b3219b4b422b79376238_ChatGPT%20Image%20Aug%206%2C%202026%2C%2001_44_45%20PM.png)

‍

You can now define a section plane by selecting three points on a 3D model. This gives you more control over the plane’s position and angle when the standard X, Y, Z, or face planes do not align with the area you want to inspect.

### How it works

Open the **Section planes** tool from the **Analyze** toolbar and turn on **3 POINT PLANE**. Select three points on the model to define the position and orientation of the plane.

Once the plane is created, use the controls in the Section planes panel to:

- Adjust its offset
- Reverse its direction
- Lock or hide it
- Reset it to its original position

### More details

- The existing X, Y, Z, and face plane options remain available
- 3-point planes can be managed alongside other active section planes from the same panel

## Review Approval and Portal Notifications

CoLab now keeps the right people informed when a review receives every required approval and when new content is uploaded to a portal.

### Review approval notifications

When every reviewer has submitted their review and selected **Approve**, CoLab notifies the review creator. Depending on the creator’s notification preferences, the notification can appear in CoLab, by email, or both.

### Portal upload notifications

Members of a portal receive a notification when someone uploads a new file or revision. This applies to portal guests and workspace team members who belong to the portal.

Portal upload notifications use the same preference as file-upload notifications for workspaces. Users can manage their delivery preferences in their notification settings.

### More details

- Approval notifications are sent only after every reviewer has submitted and approved
- Notification delivery depends on each user’s preferences
- Portal notifications cover both new files and new revisions

## AutoReview: Run Titles and Cancellation

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad0797ab514b5/6a70b03b42e18f5a186f92e0_autoreview-rename-cancel-product-update.png)

‍

AutoReview runs now receive descriptive titles based on the prompt and checklist used to start them. You can rename a run or cancel it at any stage without losing feedback that has already been generated.

### How it works

When you start an AutoReview run with a prompt, a title will be generated based on that prompt and the selected checklist. To change the title, open the run card’s three-dot menu and select **Rename**.

While a run is in progress, select the cancel button at the bottom of the AutoReview panel. Confirm the cancellation to stop the remaining analysis. Any feedback generated before the cancellation remains available with the run.

### More details

- If you do not enter a prompt, CoLab uses **General analysis** or the selected checklist’s name as the run title
- You can cancel a run at any stage
- A cancelled run cannot be resumed
- After cancelling, you can start a new run with different parameters, a different prompt, or another checklist
